description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithFluency' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue'. It implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format a value based on the 'EmployeeLanguage::FLUENCIES' array.

classes.name: FormatWithFluency
classes.description: A formatter class that maps an entity value to a fluency string using a predefined static array.
